Description: Role-aware sign-in and protected customer/admin features.
Customer event browsing, capacity validation, booking and cancellation.
Administrator event creation and booking oversight.
Testing, CI, documentation and EC2 deployment.

As a customer or administrator, I want to log in so that I access capabilities appropriate to my role. Acceptance criteria: valid credentials open role-specific navigation; invalid credentials display an error.

Summary: Set up demo accounts and session token
Description: Create customer/admin demo accounts and token-based session handling.
Protect customer booking and admin event routes.
As a customer, I want to view event information and remaining tickets so that I can choose an event. Acceptance criteria: title, date/time, venue, price and availability are visible.

As a customer, I want to book available tickets so that I receive a confirmed reservation. Acceptance criteria: quantity is a positive whole number; capacity is not exceeded; success/error feedback is displayed.
Reject invalid and over-capacity booking requests before saving data.
Show booking ID and calculated total after success.
As a customer, I want to view and cancel my booking so that I can correct an accidental reservation. Acceptance criteria: only eligible bookings display; cancellation restores capacity.
As an administrator, I want to create an event so that customers can book it. Acceptance criteria: required fields validate; price is non-negative; capacity is positive; success feedback displays.
As an administrator, I want to view all bookings so that I can monitor reservations. Acceptance criteria: booking event, customer, quantity and status display.
Run and record automated and manual tests from the test plan.
Run npm test for pushes and pull requests to main.
Configure Ubuntu EC2, security group and PM2; record public URL and instance ID.
